quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our feet when we walk outside?
quests.question: Shoes
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Shoes protect our feet from sharp rocks and hot ground!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our neck to keep cozy and warm?
quests.question: Scarf
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Scarves keep our necks warm when it snows!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our body to protect from chilly wind?
quests.question: Jacket
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Jackets keep the cold wind out so we stay cozy!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our head on a sunny day?
quests.question: Hat
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Hats block the hot sun from our eyes!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our feet under our shoes?
quests.question: Socks
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Socks keep our feet warm and make shoes comfortable!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on our hands when it is cold?

quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Gloves give our fingers a warm hug in winter!
